title: E-bike tour of Seville
text: Excellent tour of some locations not covered in all tours. Pablo spent time explaining how things we saw came to be.
author: Mark_R

title: Excellent tour
text: Excellent tour. Very knowledgeable guide and the best way to discover the sights of Seville. Would highly recommend
author: Nick_L

title: The opera singing history guide
text:
Our opera singing guide was magnificent!
Can’t recommend this highly enough. Our guide (sorry can’t remember your name paolo(?) - Pavarotti’s better looking nephew with a voice to suit. A veritable history mine, we learnt more of the History of Seville that you’d get from several lectures. A must when you first arrive in Seville and then can choose where to explore further in coming days.
author: 403damianf

title: Great tour round the city...
text: Great tour round the city with lots of historical information - our guide Paulo was brilliant and made the trip a great experience
author: Claire_T

title: Easy 5 Stars
text:
Easy 5 stars for Paolo on our E-bike tour of Seville.  We arrived at the bike shop on time and left shortly after.
Paolo started our tour with a brief history of Seville. He is a true historian and ambassador of his city. Paolo guided us to numerous landmarks while he shared insightful background at every site.  We stopped for a coffee and talked about life.  Our tour continued, covering much of Seville. Paolo kindly gave us little extra time so we could experience more of this beautiful city.  We finished with a selfie with him.  Highly recommend this bike shop and a guided tour with Paolo.
author: Kelly_d

title: Juan was amazing!
text:
We had an e-bike tour of Seville with Juan and it was one of the highlights of our trip.

Juan was an excellent guide, friendly, knowledgeable, and genuinely passionate about the city. He made the history and stories of Seville incredibly interesting and brought everything to life in a fun and engaging way. The tour was well paced, and he always made sure everyone felt safe and comfortable on the bikes.

The e-bikes were great quality and made it easy to see so much of the city without feeling rushed. We learned loads, saw places we would never have found on our own, and had a brilliant time t
author: Sian_B

title: Awesome tour with Alvaro,...
text: Awesome tour with Alvaro, who is a local and added bonus of him being a archeologist.  He shared so many local tips along with the interesting history of beautiful Seville.  We so enjoyed the tour and having his enthusiasm was the icing on the cake!
author: Marcella_M

title: Good fun tour.
text: Very friendly guide (English language). We were lucky that no other had booked and we got a private tour. Seen a lot and a lot was told.
author: InekevdMN

title: Family friendly experience in Seville
text:
We had a great experience on our bike tour in Seville and absolutely loved our guide, Juan. He was super friendly, knowledgeable, and made the whole experience really enjoyable.

He shared a lot of interesting information along the way and, most importantly, made us feel very safe—even with our 10-year-old riding with us. The bike lanes in Seville are very real and well respected. Even when it feels like you’re riding on the sidewalk, people move out of the way because it’s clearly marked, which made it much more comfortable for our family.

Because it was Semana Santa, we weren’t able to ride
author: JenniferCruz_C

title: Our first bike tour in Europe.
text: Wonderful experience riding a bike through parts of the city. The bikes are somewhat large and the shorter people in our party struggled at the start; however,  we flying along and taking in the sites in no time. Highly recommended. Our tour guide was wonderful and knowledgeable about the history and the culture of Seville.
author: Geoff_T
